title: Nice concept,  attractive with easy off and on.  Doesn't get hot enough.
text:
Nice concept, attractive with easy off and on. Doesn't get hot enough.. This is actually a beautiful coffee warmer. I like the concept of an attractive piece, and by that I mean, it is discreet and looks good in the living room! I like the easy, off and on button in the front. Very easy access.

There is also an Auto off feature. It is 8 hours. It would be better if it shut off within 3 hours at the most. I don't like that it could sit in the ON function for 8 hours......too long.

And, third, it is only 20watts. That is not any better than most of the coffee warmers. I would prefer something that keeps the coffee .... at least a little hotter than normal coffee warmers.
